p.src: Frederick called for the bill. It had a long list of items; and the waiter, with his napkin under his arm, was expecting to be paid by Frederick, when another, a sallow-faced individual, who resembled Martinon, came and said to him:

p.src: "Beg pardon; they forgot at the bar to add in the charge for the cab."

u.src: "Beg pardon; they forgot at the bar to add in the charge for the cab."

p.src: "What cab?"

p.src: "The cab the gentleman took a short time ago for the little dogs."

p.src: And the waiter put on a look of gravity, as if he pitied the poor young man. Frederick felt inclined to box the fellow's ears. He gave the waiter the twenty francs' change as a pour-boire.

p.src: "Thanks, Monseigneur," said the man with the napkin, bowing low.
